title: Transform text without splitting Unicode scalars
goal: Search or replace supplementary characters and retain explicit UTF-16 positions and replacement information.

selectionNotes: Scalars are not graphemes. UTF-16 positions count code units; invalid sequences can be replaced during enumeration.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This edition uses .NET 11 library APIs; the .NET 10 code is a comparison, not a catalogue route.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared net11.0 sample with the .NET 11 SDK.

language.name: C#
language.reason: The canonical net11.0 project selects the .NET 11 default C# 15 language mode.

prerequisites: Use a net11.0 console project with LangVersion=15.0. Include the imports stated in the recipe.
constraints: A Rune is a scalar, not a user-perceived grapheme: combining sequences and emoji clusters can contain several scalars. StartIndex/Length are UTF-16 code units for EnumerateUtf16; EnumerateUtf8 reports bytes. Invalid sequences are replaced during enumeration; use the validation recipe when rejection is required. An actual U+FFFD is not necessarily malformed input; WasReplaced distinguishes decoder replacement. Specify StringComparison for search; ordinal matching is appropriate for the marker here. TextInfo Rune overloads apply culture-aware casing; ordinal casing helpers have different semantics. StringBuilder/TextWriter Rune overloads avoid ToString adaptation but do not turn a UTF-16 char operation into grapheme editing.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 verification; GA reconciliation remains pending.
